import numpy as np

def euler_method(f, y0, t_span, n_steps):
    t = np.linspace(t_span[0], t_span[1], n_steps + 1)
    h = t[1] - t[0]
    y = np.zeros((n_steps + 1, len(y0)))
    y[0] = y0
    for i in range(n_steps):
        y[i+1] = y[i] + h * f(t[i], y[i])
    return t, y

def runge_kutta_4(f, y0, t_span, n_steps):
    t = np.linspace(t_span[0], t_span[1], n_steps + 1)
    h = t[1] - t[0]
    y = np.zeros((n_steps + 1, len(y0)))
    y[0] = y0
    for i in range(n_steps):
        k1 = h * f(t[i], y[i])
        k2 = h * f(t[i] + h/2, y[i] + k1/2)
        k3 = h * f(t[i] + h/2, y[i] + k2/2)
        k4 = h * f(t[i] + h, y[i] + k3)
        y[i+1] = y[i] + (k1 + 2*k2 + 2*k3 + k4) / 6
    return t, y

def runge_kutta_fehlberg(f, y0, t_span, tol=1e-6, h_init=0.1):
    t = [t_span[0]]
    y = [y0.copy()]
    h = h_init
    while t[-1] < t_span[1]:
        if t[-1] + h > t_span[1]:
            h = t_span[1] - t[-1]
        tn, yn = t[-1], y[-1]
        k1 = h * f(tn, yn)
        k2 = h * f(tn + h/4, yn + k1/4)
        k3 = h * f(tn + 3*h/8, yn + 3*k1/32 + 9*k2/32)
        k4 = h * f(tn + 12*h/13, yn + 1932*k1/2197 - 7200*k2/2197 + 7296*k3/2197)
        k5 = h * f(tn + h, yn + 439*k1/216 - 8*k2 + 3680*k3/513 - 845*k4/4104)
        k6 = h * f(tn + h/2, yn - 8*k1/27 + 2*k2 - 3544*k3/2565 + 1859*k4/4104 - 11*k5/40)
        y4 = yn + 25*k1/216 + 1408*k3/2565 + 2197*k4/4104 - k5/5
        y5 = yn + 16*k1/135 + 6656*k3/12825 + 28561*k4/56430 - 9*k5/50 + 2*k6/55
        error = np.linalg.norm(y5 - y4)
        if error < tol:
            t.append(tn + h)
            y.append(y5)
        h = h * min(2.0, max(0.1, 0.9 * (tol / max(error, 1e-15))**0.2))
    return np.array(t), np.array(y)
